layers.name: Input layer · Signal and cash
layers.role: Sell expertise directly. Every engagement produces cash, buyer questions, anonymised cases and market intelligence.
layers.consumes: Your expertise, network and time; no capital
layers.produces: First USD, buyer questions, case studies, pricing data, first audience
layers.trigger: Start now. Each stream risks at most a few hundred dollars.

layers.name: Hidden layer 1 · Encode into IP
layers.role: Turn the questions and models from layer 1 into products that sell without your hours, and lead magnets that feed layer 1 back.
layers.consumes: Repeated client questions, models built for clients, teardown data
layers.produces: Templates, kits and toolkits; free tools that capture emails; credibility
layers.trigger: Opens once layer 1 has brought in its first US$1k; paid from the growth fund.

layers.name: Hidden layer 2 · Amplify distribution
layers.role: Multiply reach: channels and partners that carry layer 2 products to buyers you cannot reach one by one.
layers.consumes: Products and IP from layer 2; content from layer 1
layers.produces: Audience at scale, email list, partner and marketplace channels, referral income
layers.trigger: Opens when net income is US$2k+/month for 2 months.

layers.name: Output layer · Convert trust into high-ticket
layers.role: Monetise the audience and credibility built upstream with retainers, success fees and deal flow.
layers.consumes: Inbound trust from layers 2-3, case studies, network
layers.produces: Retainers, success fees, deal flow, the US$10k floor
layers.trigger: Opens when net income is US$5k+/month and the growth fund holds US$3k+.

layers.name: Scale layer · Compound with capital and team
layers.role: Use the growth fund, proprietary data and a small team to build assets that keep earning.
layers.consumes: Growth fund, data from every layer, analysts
layers.produces: Data and software assets, team-delivered services, capital gains
layers.trigger: Opens when net income clears US$10k/month for 3 months and the growth fund holds US$10k+.
